title: The icon in the sidebar (next to search) stopped working,

messages.content:
[Attached image: c:\Users\russp\Documents\Meridian\.tasker\chats\bbbc6ea9\attachments\Screenshot_2026-07-27_085636.png]

The icon in the sidebar (next to search) stopped working, and we need to make sure that the pinned Meridian tab is more persistent (can't close it, can't navigate away from it), and that any new window opens with the pinned tab.
messages.editable_content: The icon in the sidebar (next to search) stopped working, and we need to make sure that the pinned Meridian tab is more persistent (can't close it, can't navigate away from it), and that any new window opens with the pinned tab.

messages.content:
Implemented.

- Sidebar Meridian icon now focuses the correct window’s Meridian tab and recreates it if missing.
- Every normal Chrome window gets its own pinned Meridian tab.
- Closed tabs are immediately restored unless the whole window is closing.
- Unpinned or moved Meridian tabs are restored to pinned position 0.
- Navigation attempts open in a separate tab while Meridian restores itself.
- Source and packaged extension copies remain synchronized.
- Added lifecycle/navigation regression coverage.
